summary: Search the web, read pages, list a site's pages and crawl it. Tries Tavily, then Firecrawl, then Firecrawl Local, then Scrapy.

tools.name: tool_web_search
tools.purpose: Search the web; returns titles, addresses and snippets.

tools.name: tool_web_readPage
tools.purpose: Read the text of one web page.
tools.connection: Tavily, Firecrawl, Firecrawl Local or Scrapy

tools.name: tool_web_map
tools.purpose: List the pages found on a site.
tools.connection: Tavily, Firecrawl, Firecrawl Local or Scrapy

tools.name: tool_web_crawl
tools.purpose: Crawl a site and return the text of its pages.
tools.connection: Tavily, Firecrawl, Firecrawl Local or Scrapy

params.name: query
params.description: What to search for, as a plain search query.

params.name: max_results
params.description: How many results to return (1 to 10).

params.name: topic
params.description: news for recent events, else general.

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address.

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address of the site or section.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many pages to list at most (1 to 500).

params.name: url
params.description: The full http:// or https:// address where the crawl starts.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many pages to read at most (1 to 25).

workflow.explanation: Read the best one or two pages.
To work through one site, list its pages and pick.
Crawl from a starting address when you need many pages.
